mast_foot.contact_explanation: Matching zero-clearance mortise side faces slide in coplanar contact until the 120 mm tenon clears. These triangle overlaps are not positive penetration. Nonmanifold Boolean intersections cannot supply valid volume.
mast_foot.limitations: 109 finite positions, including 101 equal increments and eight extra near-seat positions; no physical tolerance, friction, rotational-locking, strength or general continuous-path certificate. Can be withdrawn vertically; not self-locking.
